test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a circular table facing the center.

A is second to the left of D.

B is to the immediate right of A.

C is opposite B.

F is between C and D.

H is not an immediate neighbor of D.

G is to the immediate right of H.

Who is sitting to the immediate left of H?
solution:
Given: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a circular table facing the center.

A is second to the left of D.

B is to the immediate right of A.

C is opposite B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f10ea98b98a460c5122b9839b0372ad061e76fd7592832446a974581a08593ef.png] 

H is not an immediate neighbor of D.

G is to the immediate right of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32a9e46e42c7a56cb8ab646fc247299b241e48aae2884ca3d017cdc0b1cb6951.png] 

F is between C and D.

Possible seating arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e4e9acecfcd634971728263a8f2abcfe767b621884859ad18056ba6922c355b.png] 

So, C is sitting to the immediate left of H.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
